Access starts from the cited provider page or document; no underlying files were retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): COCO License 3.10 (free use and distribution). Price and access terms require confirmation with the provider. Documentation does not establish completeness, calibration quality or suitability for a particular simulation. For infrastructure simulation, it can support process, production or industrial-exposure scenario development.
